cases.sentence: Грех ___ начертан железным резцом на их окаменевших сердцах.
cases.translation: The sin of Judah is written with an iron pen on hardened hearts.
cases.explain: Possessive genitive shows whose sin it is.

cases.sentence: Даже их дети помнят эти жертвенники на высоких холмах и на ___ страны.
cases.translation: Their children remember these altars on high hills and mountains.
cases.explain: Preposition на with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я отдам тебя в рабство твоим ___, в страну, которая тебе незнакома.
cases.translation: I will make you serve your enemies in a land unknown to you.
cases.explain: Dative case indicates the purpose or recipient of servitude.

cases.sentence: Он будет как куст в пустыне, не увидит, как явится ___.
cases.translation: He will be like a shrub in the desert and will not see good come.
cases.explain: Subject of явится (comes) requires nominative case.

cases.sentence: Благословен полагающийся на ___, чье упование Господь.
cases.translation: Blessed is he who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is the Lord.
cases.explain: Trusting in God expressed with genitive case (на Господа).

cases.sentence: Я, Господь, испытываю разум, чтобы воздать по плодам его ___.
cases.translation: I, the Lord, examine minds to give according to the fruit of his works.
cases.explain: Possessive genitive in плодам его рук (fruits of his hands).

cases.sentence: Как куропатка сидит на яйцах, которых она не несла, так и тот, кто копит богатство ___.
cases.translation: As a partridge gathers eggs she did not lay, so is he who gains riches unjustly.
cases.explain: Adverb modifies how the wealth is gathered.

cases.sentence: Славный престол, вознесенный извечно, — вот место святыни ___.
cases.translation: A glorious throne exalted from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
cases.explain: Possessive genitive нас in святыни нас (our sanctuary).

reading.ru: Грех Иудеи начертан железным резцом, вырезан алмазным острием на их окаменевших сердцах.
reading.question: How is Judah's sin described?
options: Written with iron pen, engraved on hardened hearts
reading.correct: Written with iron pen, engraved on hardened hearts
reading.explain: Sin is deeply and permanently inscribed.

reading.ru: Благословен полагающийся на Господа, чье упование Господь, он будет как дерево, посаженное у воды.
reading.question: What blessing is promised to those who trust God?
options: They will be like a tree planted by water
reading.correct: They will be like a tree planted by water
reading.explain: Such trust brings stability and fruitfulness.

reading.ru: Сердце лукавее всего и неисцелимо, кто в силах понять его?
reading.question: What is said about the human heart?
options: It is deceitful and incurable; who can understand it?
reading.correct: It is deceitful and incurable; who can understand it?
reading.explain: Expresses the fundamental corruption of human nature.

reading.ru: Я, Господь, проникаю в сердце и испытываю разум, чтобы каждому воздать по поступкам.
reading.question: What does the Lord do to judge fairly?
options: He searches hearts and examines minds to judge by deeds
reading.correct: He searches hearts and examines minds to judge by deeds
reading.explain: God's judgment is omniscient and just.

reading.ru: Не боится оно, что настанет зной, листья его пребудут зелеными, не тревожится в год засушливый.
reading.question: What protection does the tree by water have?
options: Its leaves stay green; it is not worried in drought
reading.correct: Its leaves stay green; it is not worried in drought
reading.explain: Metaphor for the faithful person's security.

reading.ru: Господь, надежда Израиля, всякий, кто оставит тебя, будет опозорен.
reading.question: What happens to those who forsake God?
options: They will be put to shame
reading.correct: They will be put to shame
